Bash(git -C "C:/projects/space-shooter" commit -m "$\(cat <<''EOF''
Fix boss UFO invincibility caused by swapped overlap callback args

Phaser 3.90 does not guarantee argument order in overlap callbacks.
handleBulletHitUFO received the UFO as obj1 \(assumed to be the bullet\),
deactivated it, then applyBulletHit returned early on the inactive check
— hitPoints never decremented. ensureCombatReady reactivated the UFO
each frame, making it permanently invincible.

Fix: use identity checks to determine which object is the bullet vs UFO.
Also fix handlePlayerHitUFOProjectile for the same potential issue.

Adds boss energy bar with segmented display, hit-count label, and
animated damage drain. Updates docs to reflect boss UFO features and
the Phaser overlap argument order pitfall.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.6 <noreply@anthropic.com>
EOF
\)")
